markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (82%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Severe blur on this simulated frozen section flagged reliability; recut, deeper levels, and margin deferral [F7] are drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 82%, Invasive 13%, Benign 5%, Normal 0% [F1] | Favors InSitu; 13% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% target (test 90%, CI 76%–98%, n=132) | Dataset-level guarantee, not case probability |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 44% (flagged), OOD 96th percentile (error AUROC 0.70) [F6] | Suspect input; atypical blurred image |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top-class disagreement) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 60% (3/5) InSitu (80%–81%); top 2 Benign (82%–84%) [F5] | Mixed neighbors; closest two Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Typical level (+0.27 invasive push [F2]); AI spot check 8/20 · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Typical score pushes toward invasive (+0.163 [F3]); 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score pulls against invasion (-0.161 [F4]); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.34 SD) reduces invasive risk (-0.133); 18/20 spot check · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Average score pulls against invasion (-0.123); 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability vs random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unverified for classifier faithfulness (+0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); relies on unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20 spot-checked).

## Could be wrong if
- Severe blur (severity 3) masks benign mimicry; the two closest reference cases (84%, 82% similarity) are Benign.
- Blurred frozen artifacts obscure focal stromal invasion in high-risk region 9 (55% risk) or misdirect discordant foundation models.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 8, 2, 3**: Inspect highest-risk heatmap tiles (55% in region 9; 15%–18% others) for invasion.
2. **Regions 7, 11, 5**: Check duct confinement, pleomorphism, and stroma versus Benign contrast case BACH_0330.
3. **Region 6**: Verify TILs and mitoses; consider drafted recut H&E, deeper levels, and permanent margins.
